summary: Mutual-fund masterclass with 4 guests: Gajendra Kothari, Radhika Gupta (MD & CEO, Edelweiss MF), Dhirendra Kumar (Value Research), Vijay Mantri. Key takeaways: Rs 98,000/month SIP at 12% for 20 years ~ Rs 10 cr corpus; SIPs work best in falling markets (worst 10-yr SIP return on their oldest midcap fund was 9%, best 18-19%). Fund selection: stick to 4-5 core categories (flexi/large+mid/multi/mid/small cap), trust the AMC, read the portfolio, judge by 5-year rolling returns; quality = 3-5 yr track record through downturns, consistent thought process reflected in portfolio, same manager, skin-in-the-game. Mantri's personal picks (named, not advice): Parag Parikh Flexi Cap, HDFC Flexi Cap, an Edelweiss/IFA value fund, and a volatile FANG+ 10-stock index fund. Sector/thematic view: prefers thematic (consumption, energy, BFSI) over narrow sectoral funds; Nifty 500 > Nifty 50. Calls: none - mutual funds only.
